items.html: And if you should say: why were the vessels marked and alluded to in the two first Nekudot, which are the most excellent of them all? Indeed, the matter is that from these two first Nekudot, which are Keter and Hochma of the Nekudot, as is known, vessels were made for the rest, and they are the ones that begot and brought out vessels for the Sefirot beneath them. There is a second reason as well: for it is known that the seven lower Nekudot are the seven kings that died, whereas the first ones did not die. And it is known that the discernment of death is the breaking of the vessel; therefore the other seven Nekudot remained without a vessel, with light alone, which is the discernment of the Nekudot. But the first ones, who did not die and remained with their vessels, their lights are concealed and clothed inside the vessels, and they are named after the vessels, which are the twenty-two lights alluded to in Kamatz and Patach, as mentioned.
